name: agent_files_init
title: Agent File Scaffold
description: Scaffold AGENT.md, AGENT_GOAL.md, AGENT_HARNESS.md, and AGENT_PROGRESS.md templates into a target directory under a strict four-file contract

target_dir.description: Directory where the four agent files will be scaffolded

mission.description: Long-term mission string written into AGENT_GOAL.md. Required so the scaffolded contract is internally consistent on first read; the agent cannot edit AGENT_GOAL.md after scaffold without explicit user instruction

objective.description: Concrete in-flight objective written into AGENT_PROGRESS.md. If omitted, the scaffolded AGENT_PROGRESS.md omits the Current Objective section entirely rather than leaving a literal placeholder

overwrite.description: If true, existing files in target_dir are replaced; if false, existing files are skipped
